annotations.title: Uptime check, website status: is it up and how fast

description: Check whether a website is up right now: one live request (following redirects) with the HTTP status, up or down, response time in ms, the final URL, content type, server header and page size, and optionally whether the page contains a given text. Timeouts and connection failures come back as down with the reason, not as an error. Use for uptime monitoring, health checks before calling an API, or to confirm a deploy. Example: url=https://www.wikipedia.org/. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

contains.description: Optional text that must appear in the page (first 500 KB)
